```{r}
#| label: setup

library(tidyverse)
library(showtext)
library(sysfonts)

font_add(
  family  = "big_shoulders",
  regular = here::here("fonts/BigShoulders-VariableFont_opsz,wght.ttf")
)
font_add(
  family  = "dm_sans",
  regular = here::here("fonts/DMSans-VariableFont_opsz,wght.ttf"),
  italic  = here::here("fonts/DMSans-Italic-VariableFont_opsz,wght.ttf")
)
font_add(
  family  = "jetbrains_mono",
  regular = here::here("fonts/JetBrainsMono-VariableFont_wght.ttf"),
  italic  = here::here("fonts/JetBrainsMono-Italic-VariableFont_wght.ttf")
)
showtext_auto()
showtext_opts(dpi = 320)

pal <- list(
  abyss = "#07142F",
  tide  = "#102447",
  reef  = "#4FE0CC",
  coral = "#FF7A59",
  sun   = "#FFC857",
  sand  = "#F2EDE2",
  mist  = "#6E83AB"
)

theme_pacific <- function() {
  theme_minimal(base_family = "dm_sans") +
    theme(
      plot.background  = element_rect(fill = pal$abyss, color = NA),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = pal$abyss, color = NA),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "#2A4A87", linewidth = 0.25),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(
        family = "big_shoulders", face = "bold",
        size = 42, color = "white", margin = margin(b = 8)
      ),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(
        family = "dm_sans", size = 13,
        color = pal$sand, margin = margin(b = 24)
      ),
      axis.title  = element_blank(),
      axis.text   = element_text(color = pal$mist, size = 10),
      plot.caption = element_text(
        family = "jetbrains_mono", color = pal$mist,
        size = 8.5, hjust = 0
      ),
      plot.margin = margin(24, 32, 24, 32)
    )
}

set.seed(2026)
temp_df <- tibble(
  year    = 2000:2026,
  anomaly = cumsum(rnorm(27, mean = 0.035, sd = 0.055))
)
```

```{r}
#| label: save-chart
#| include: false

p <- ggplot(temp_df, aes(year, anomaly)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = pal$mist, linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_line(color = pal$reef, linewidth = 1.4) +
  geom_point(color = pal$reef, size = 2.2) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 2022, y = max(temp_df$anomaly) * 0.9,
    label  = "warming signal",
    family = "jetbrains_mono",
    color  = pal$coral, size = 3.2, hjust = 0
  ) +
  labs(
    title    = "Warming Currents",
    subtitle = "Fake temperature anomaly · Pacific Currents visual system",
    caption  = "Prototype only · simulated data"
  ) +
  theme_pacific()

ggsave("chart_temp.png", p, width = 9, height = 5, dpi = 320, bg = pal$abyss)
```

# Pacific Currents — Prototype

<div class="eyebrow">CLOSEREAD TEST · FAKE DATA · MAY 2026</div>

This page tests whether a ggplot2 chart renders inside a Closeread sticky section using the Pacific Currents visual system.

:::{.cr-section}

When this chart scrolls into view, it stays fixed while the story unfolds. @cr-temp-chart

The Pacific Ocean has been warming for decades. Each year adds a fraction of a degree — invisible in isolation, unmistakable over time. @cr-temp-chart

The trend accelerates sharply after 2015, as ocean heat accumulates faster than at any point in the instrumental record. @cr-temp-chart
